snippet.title: Location Withheld (Demake) - 3 Endings - Investigate a Mysterious Case Files | Indie Horror Games
snippet.description:
"A short horror in which you find yourself in an unfamiliar office..."

Location Withheld Demake is a PSX-styled demake of Location Withheld. It's a short horror experience focused on creating an immersive atmosphere in which you find yourself in an unfamiliar office surrounded by mysterious case files.

A Game by Bryce Bucher.

Location Witheld: https://bryce-bucher.itch.io/location-withheld-demake
